title: Original post facts retain article roles and source evidence in brief routing
steps: Run the brief item routing tests on builder-produced briefs and the current brief schema.
expect: Original post facts route to article title, lead and date without changing their source evidence.
Every item kind produced by the current brief schema and builder has roles or an explicit reason.
Unknown item kinds still appear as unrouted instead of being silently accepted.
fence: A route maps existing facts to existing article roles; it creates no content, photo, date or source evidence.

tests: original post facts route to article copy and dates without losing their source evidence
no item of a fictional brief is without a role or a reason
a kind with no row is reported as unrouted
every kind the brief schema and the builder can produce has a row
